errors.evidence: The description omits the unit of the y-axis, which is percentage (%).
The description fails to mention that the blue line is dashed, not solid.
The description does not mention the error bars present on the data points of the black line.
The description states the green line starts at approximately 2.7 in 2013, but the chart clearly shows the value is 2.5.
The description states the blue line starts at approximately 2.1 in 2013, but the chart clearly shows the value is 2.0.
The description states the blue line ends at approximately 3.9 in 2022, but the chart shows the data point is exactly on the 4.0 grid line.
The description states the black line starts at approximately 0.6 in 2013, but the chart shows the data point is exactly on the 0.5 grid line.
The description states the black line ends at approximately 0.9 in 2022. The actual value is closer to 0.8, making 0.9 an overestimation.
